title: TN Selection Committee notifies ineligible candidates; grievance window open till 7 Aug

  • Submit the necessary supporting documents online.
  • Check ineligibility status under all applied categories.
  • Deadline: 7 Aug 2026, 3:00 PM (server time).

  • No timeline extensions; counselling follows DGHS/MCC guidelines.

If a grievance is not submitted in time, the committee's decision of ineligibility is taken as accepted.

title: Counselling timeline shifted too
summary: MCC registration was expected around 21 July 2026 (tentative). The whole cycle is running roughly two months behind a typical year; check mcc.nic.in for the confirmed schedule.
details:
The delay traces back to the original NEET UG 2026 exam being cancelled and re-conducted. In a typical year AIQ Round 1 registration opens within days of results; this year the gap is closer to a month.

Expect Round 1 allotment in late July, Rounds 2 and 3 through August–September, and the Stray Vacancy round around October. All of this stays provisional until MCC's official notification.

If you are also considering an abroad option as a backup, most partner universities' intakes run later in the year, so this delay does not meaningfully shrink those options.

title: Marks vs rank, explained
summary: In 2025, 502 marks was worth roughly AIR 50,000. This year it takes 535 marks for the same rank, so do not compare your score with last year's "safe" numbers.
details:
YearMarksApprox. rank
2025502AIR 50,000
2026 (Re-NEET)535AIR 50,000

That is 33 more marks for the same rank. This is a structural shift, not normal variance: the Re-NEET was a different paper, difficulty curve and candidate pool (22+ lakh).

Wait for MCC's round-wise closing ranks once counselling starts, and treat any pre-counselling college predictor with real caution this year.

Source: official NTA marks-vs-rank data.

title: Why this year is different
summary: The original NEET UG 2026 exam (3 May) was cancelled after paper leak allegations. NTA conducted a fresh Re-NEET on 21 June 2026 with 22+ lakh candidates.
details:
This is the first time in recent years NTA has had to fully re-conduct NEET UG at this scale. The knock-on effects: a compressed gap between result and counselling, a counselling schedule pushed about two months later than usual, and a different score distribution that makes historical comparisons unreliable.

If you were counting on a score or rank being "safe" based on past years, re-check that assumption once MCC publishes round-wise data.

title: Philippine MD degrees confirmed NMC-compliant
summary: The Embassy of India in Manila confirmed that the 54-month MD programme at CHED-recognised Philippine institutions meets India's Foreign Medical Graduate Licentiate requirements.
details:
Per CHED's May 2025 letter, compliance requires the mandatory subjects in NMC's November 2021 notification, fully English-medium instruction, a 12-month internship at the same institution or hospital, and a Certificate of Registrability. The Philippine House of Representatives separately passed Resolution No. 73 in March 2026 endorsing the same compliance.

Practising within the Philippines still requires the local Physician Licensure Examination, and only if India extends equivalent reciprocity to Filipino graduates; that guidance is still awaited. This does not affect graduates planning to practise in India, the US, UK, Canada, Australia or several other countries.

Always verify NMC compliance for your specific university; this advisory covers CHED-recognised institutions generally.
